literal_meaning: সাতটি হাটের কানাকড়ি (seven markets' scraps or odds and ends)
figurative_meaning_en: miscellaneous or varied talks, often gossip or complaints from various sources
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সুযোগ পেয়ে আমাকে সাতহাটের কানাকড়ি শোনাল।
এই নানাকথায় কান না দিয়ে কাজে মন দাও।
example_sentences_in_english: Upon getting the chance, he bombarded me with scraps from seven markets.
Don't pay attention to this mishmash of gossip and focus on your work.
note: Refers to the traditional Bengali market (haat) culture where people gather and exchange news or complaints.
